// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the dashboard.
Code* (string)::
Code of the dashboard, used in the links of the viewer.
Name* (string)::
Name shown in the viewer.
Description (string)::
What the dashboard shows.
Builtin* (boolean)::
Seeded by the install of the trait: it is not edited nor deleted, only duplicated.
Source variable* (boolean)::
The dashboard is a template applied to an origin chosen in the viewer ($source).
Source kind (ObservedDashboardSourceKindOptions)::
For a template, the kind of origin it is the default dashboard of.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * backend
 * frontend
 * worker
 * mobile

Default range* (ObservedDashboardDefaultRangeOptions)::
Time range shown when the dashboard is opened.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * hour
 * six-hours
 * day
 * week
 * month

Refresh* (ObservedDashboardRefreshOptions)::
Automatic refresh interval of the dashboard; manual to refresh only on demand.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * manual
 * ten-seconds
 * thirty-seconds
 * minute
 * five-minutes

Panels (xref:#entidad-observed-panel[ObservedPanel])::
Panels of the dashboard.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de observed dashboard para controlar bloqueos optimistas
